fact: On 7 July 2026 the Algiers court of appeal upheld journalist Saâd Bouakba's conviction with an 18-month suspended sentence and a one million dinar fine, and the online outlet Rassd was permanently closed and its equipment seized.
title: Algérie : « Committee for Justice » : La condamnation en appel du journaliste Saâd Bouakba et la fermeture du média « Rassd » aggravent la censure du débat public
